name: commerce_event_raw
description: Immutable landing zone. One object per synthetic commerce event. Schema is best-effort; Silver is the first validation boundary.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Stable event identifier. Seed format: evt-{seed:04d}-{i:06d}.

fields.name: event_ts
fields.description: Event occurrence time (ISO-8601). Partition date is taken from this timestamp.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Business event class. Unknown values are quarantined in Silver.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units. Bronze may land 0; Silver rejects non-positive.
